reason: I already have an SMS account with my sender name approved and my lists sitting there, and it works. LKR 560 is nothing to me, but moving my lists, getting my mask approved again and retraining my staff right before 12.12 is a risk I don't need without a clear reason.
objection: Switching providers right before my biggest sale. If the new sender name or delivery fails during 12.12, I lose far more than I save, and 1,000 credits doesn't even cover one blast to all my branches' customers.
would_change_my_mind: A clearly lower bulk rate than what I pay now on 50,000+ SMS a month, shown side by side, with proof of delivery rates from other chain stores.
